actions.title: Run synthesis pass on 396 (ingredient, metal) cells that have 2+ contributing sources
actions.closes_what: ingredient contamination_profile cells move from pending to populated per CLAUDE.md Part 9 incremental-update rules
actions.details: 1585 ingredient × metal cells are currently pending. Of those, 396 have 2+ A-tier sources contributing values per the routing audit and are eligible for initial-population synthesis. The remaining 1189 cells have 0-1 contributing sources and need more corpus before synthesis runs.

actions.title: Recover real DOIs for 92 source pages currently marked no_doi_assigned with Scholar fallback
actions.closes_what: provenance debt from 2026-05-13 publish run (wiki/lint/2026-05-13-doi-fallback-followup.md); restores real DOI + publisher access URLs in place of Scholar search fallbacks
actions.best_dispatched_to: Claude Code Opus (small structured edits, occasional DOI lookup)
actions.details: Each page has its raw_path pointing to the Marker-converted markdown. DOI is usually on page 1 of the paper; if not, query Crossref / OpenAlex / Semantic Scholar by title+author+year. Replace doi: null + no_doi_assigned: true + Scholar URL with the real DOI + matching publisher access_url. If no DOI exists after exhaustive search, keep no_doi_assigned: true but replace the Scholar URL with a venue/publisher URL.

actions.title: Populate 314 *[awaiting synthesis]* cells in source-legend tables across 173 pages
actions.closes_what: the "Used on this page for" column in the hmi-source-legend table on every product, ingredient, and metal page — the brand-legal-facing scannable provenance surface Karen prioritized as standard format on 2026-05-13
actions.best_dispatched_to: Claude Code Opus (per-source contextual synthesis at scale)
actions.details: 314 cells across 173 pages. Each cell needs a 1-sentence description of what the source contributes to this specific page. Read the source page TL;DR + the consumer page body, then patch the cell. Idempotent: re-running on already-filled cells is a no-op.

actions.title: Triage 208 routing-unresolved entries
actions.closes_what: downstream routing audit noise; surfaces new-page proposals per CLAUDE.md Part 10
actions.best_dispatched_to: Claude Code Opus (analytical: typo fix vs new page vs detector bug)
actions.details: 208 entries broken down as: 169 ingredient, 39 product. Most are auto-fixable frontmatter typos; ~5% need Karen's approval for new-page creation above the Part 10 5-paper threshold.

actions.title: Expand wishlist for 33 (product, metal) cells with no structured evidence loaded
actions.closes_what: standards-readiness gaps where no concentration data exists in the corpus for this matrix-metal combination
actions.details: 33 cells blocked because no source provides concentration data for the (product, metal) combination. The wishlist generator can target these specifically by injecting product+metal queries; auto-fetch then runs against the expanded queries.

actions.title: Draft missing mandatory sections on 125 non-stub ingredient pages
actions.closes_what: ingredient pages missing one or more of the eight mandatory sections per CLAUDE.md Part 6 (Why this commodity accumulates, contamination_profile body table, Ranges by source/region/variety, Processing effects, Ingredient-derivative risk, Mitigation options, Regulatory limits, Sources). The Mitigation options section is the load-bearing addition — most pages are missing it.
actions.best_dispatched_to: Claude Code Opus (per-page section drafting from routing audit + source pages)
actions.details: Each page needs the missing sections drafted from the routing audit's contributing sources. Autonomous; no Karen review required. The subprocess reads the page, identifies contributing sources via routing audit, reads the top 3-5 source TL;DRs, drafts each missing section per the Part 6 template, commits in batches of 10-15 pages.

actions.title: Ingest 97 staged PDFs and produce source pages
actions.closes_what: wishlist gaps (each PDF likely closes one or more) + brings ingredient/product pages closer to populated
actions.best_dispatched_to: Obsidian Sonnet (cheaper per-token for bulk work)
actions.details: 97 files in raw/manual-fetch/seasonal-geographic-variance/ (manual drops + auto-fetched). Each produces a source page per CLAUDE.md Part 8; routing audit fans them out automatically via the watcher.
